Name: Simply Harvey - Harvey Portrait Mod
Author: Azurysu
Description:
[b][size=3]This is a portrait mod for Harvey, made to look as closely as his portraits from the base game, but (even) more handsome! [/size][/b]I tried to be as faithful as possible to the original design, but changing the things I thought that needed a revamp the most (like his eyes only being green on the blushing portraits or his expressions, for example).

Comes with new portraits for the beach and winter outfits too.

I'm developing at the moment a mod that expands on Harvey's character adding new heart scenes, dialogue and many more cool things. Once I have a stable enough version and upload it to Nexus, I will update this mod to include the custom portraits from it!

I'll try to update this mod to also include custom sprites alongside these portraits! I don't have much free time right now, but I want to do it at some point.

Installation:

[list]
[*]Unzip contents to the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Load game with SMAPI and you are good to go!

[/list]
